verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a voice-assistant platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows the 01 is open-source and runs on your own computer, but nothing documents a data-export feature or open export formats. Local hosting and open-source code are adjacent properties, not an export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
